subject: Odd behavior with inputs in DataTable

messages.author: c0c84142ff215f59
messages.subject: Odd behavior with inputs in DataTable
parts:
Hello everyone,

I am having trouble getting inputs in a DataTable to work properly. I find that when a DataTable first renders with inputs that it works totally fine, but if you render the table again (because the data changed or for some other reason) the inputs in the DataTable go to null like you would expect, but the values for those inputs in the server keep the old values even when you update the table again. Here is an example:

library(shiny) 
library(DT) 
shinyApp( 
  ui = fluidPage(
    sidebarPanel(
      # choose dataset
      selectInput("select","Choose dataset",c("mtcars","iris"))),
      # display table
        mainPanel(DT::dataTableOutput('x1'),
          verbatimTextOutput("out"))), 
  
  server = function(input, output) { 
    # function for dynamic inputs in DT
    shinyInput <- function(FUN,id,num,...) {
      inputs <- character(num)
      for (i in seq_len(num)) {
        inputs[i] <- as.character(FUN(paste0(id,i),label=NULL,...))
      }
      inputs
    }
    # function to read DT inputs
    shinyValue <- function(id,num) {
      unlist(lapply(seq_len(num),function(i) {
        value <- input[[paste0(id,i)]]
        if (is.null(value)) NA else value
      }))
    }
    # reactive dataset
    data <- reactive({
      req(input$select)
      get(input$select)[1:5,1:3]
    })
    # render datatable with inputs
    output$x1 <- DT::renderDataTable({
      data.frame(data(),ENTER = shinyInput(numericInput,"numin",nrow(data()),value=NULL))
    },server=FALSE,escape=FALSE,selection='none',
    options=list(preDrawCallback=JS(
      'function() {
     Shiny.unbindAll(this.api().table().node());}'),
      drawCallback= JS(
        'function(settings) {
       Shiny.bindAll(this.api().table().node());}')))
    # render output of entered values
    output$out <- renderPrint(
      data.frame(v1=shinyValue("numin",nrow(data()))))
  }
) 

When opened, it gives you the first 3 cols of mtcars and a numericInput. If you enter things into the numericInput they are printed below so it works. Now change the dataset to iris using the selectInput, and you get a new DataTable with Iris and a numericInput with no values. But below it is still printing the values I entered for mtcars, even when I enter new values.

Am I misunderstanding how Shiny binds things with javascript or is this a bug?

Regards
